title: Light bulb with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow around bulb -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='36' fill='#FFD54A' opacity='0.18'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='30' fill='#FFD54A' opacity='0.22'/>
  
  <!-- bulb glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='24' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='24' fill='#FFEEB0' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- inner shine -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#FFF8D6' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='4' fill='#FFF8D6' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- filament glow inside -->
  <path d='M44 46 Q47 50 50 46 Q53 42 56 46' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='37' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='37' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE7'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE7'/>
  
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='45' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='45' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.55'/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 47 Q50 56 58 47' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- base / screw threads -->
  <rect x='37' y='60' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
  <rect x='36' y='65' width='28' height='5' rx='2' fill='#90A4AE'/>
  <rect x='37' y='70' width='26' height='5' rx='2' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
  
  <!-- contact tip -->
  <path d='M44 75 Q44 82 50 84 Q56 82 56 75 Z' fill='#78909C'/>
  <path d='M47 75 Q47 80 50 81 Q53 80 53 75 Z' fill='#A0B4BE'/>
</svg>
